objects.string: Necromancer, Keeper of the Red Flame

content.text: Necromancer, Keeper of the Red Flame

events.comment: NECROMANCER BOSS FIGHT. Player controls as in the tutorial. Bolts can be rolled through (i-frames). Hitting it fills its posture; a posture break stuns it and your hits do triple damage. F5 restarts, F3 debug draw.

parameters: assets/Music/Faded Keys_Broken Piano_Horror Music_Royalty Free Music_Vivek Abhishek.mp3

events.comment: Holds his ground and faces the player; only drifts closer if you run far away. Blinks to the other side after taking 5 hits up close (8 s cooldown), with a 0.6 s purple warning first.
Attack 1 = aimed bolt, 2 = 3-bolt spread, 3 = bolt rain from above (phase 2 only).
Phase 2 at half health: roar, faster attacks, unlocks the bolt rain.
